messages.author: 4de26959f6d811fb
messages.subject: ggtree, label
parts:
Hello,

I have very long branch labels. Is it possible to specify the labels to wrap to multiple lines if it's longer than the branch length.

p <- p %<+% lab
p + geom_tiplab(aes(subset=(grepl('',label,fixed=TRUE)==TRUE))) + geom_text(aes(x=branch, label=diff), hjust=0.01, vjust=-0.3, size=3, color="red") 

Thanks

messages.author: cec41188340e8212

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: ggtree, label
parts:
str_wrap breaks only at white space and your long-string text doesn’t contain any.

> gsub(",", ", ", lab$diff) -> lab$diff 
> p = ggtree(tree) ; p <- p %<+% lab 
> p + geom_nodelab(aes(x=branch, label=str_wrap(diff, width=20)), size=3, color="red")

should works.
